blocks.html: Robinsons Land Corporation’s newest premium lifestyle destination, Opus, ushered in the holiday season with “A Christmas Masterpiece” — an extraordinary night of music, flavor, and elegance. More than a holiday celebration, the event signaled RLC’s bold foray into the premium lifestyle space, ushering in a new era of sophistication and innovation as it continues to create world-class destinations.
Held on November 10 at Opus in Bridgetowne Destination Estate, the event brought together distinguished guests, industry leaders, and Quezon City officials to celebrate the spirit of Christmas.

Hosted by Tim Yap, the evening’s highlight was a stunning performance by theater luminary Rachelle Ann Go and the Philippine Philharmonic Orchestra (PPO). Their world-class artistry and captivating performances held the audience in awe at the Opus Grand Atrium, which was transformed into a breathtaking stage for a truly magical holiday celebration. Adding to the evening’s allure was a curated culinary showcase, featuring dishes specially crafted by Opus’ esteemed dining partners.

The celebration culminated with the grand lighting of the Opus 60-foot Christmas Tree — a breathtaking and luminous holiday centerpiece, followed by a champagne toast led by Councilor Albert Alvin “Chuckie” Antonio III and Marge Santos-Mejia, Head of Business Permits and Licensing, representing Honorable Joy Belmonte, Mayor of Quezon City; James L. Go, Chairman of JG Summit Holdings Inc.; Robina Y. Gokongwei-Pe, Chairman of Robinsons Retail Holdings, Inc.; Mybelle V. Aragon-GoBio, President and CEO of Robinsons Land Corporation; and Faraday Go, Executive Vice President and Business Unit General Manager of the Commercial Centers Division, Robinsons Land Corporation.

Opus continues to redefine the modern mall experience in the Philippines, a place where business, leisure, and community come together harmoniously. Since its opening in 2024, this shopping mall has become a vibrant hub where people gather, connect, and find inspiration from its curated experiences and elevated environment.

“Opus Mall’s design aesthetics goes beyond the shoppers’ regular needs,” said Ms. Kristina R. Lim, Vice President for Lease of Robinsons Malls. “Meticulously and thoughtfully designed spaces, refined architecture, and a carefully curated mix of retail, dining, and entertainment make every visit at Opus feel intentional and elevated.”

“Our vision has always been to create destinations that elevate how people live, connect, and experience life,” said Mybelle V. Aragon-Go Bio, President and CEO of Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC). “Opus, is our latest expression of Robinsons Land’s commitment to elevating the way people live, work, and gather.”

It is home to several “first-in-the-market concepts” that redefine the modern mall experience including Spatio, the first integrated shop-within-a-shop lifestyle destination that brings together upscale retail, a barber lounge, wine bar, café, and waxing salon in one curated space. Dave & Buster’s, the iconic American “eatertainment” brand, makes its Southeast Asian debut at Opus, seamlessly blending gourmet dining with immersive interactive play. On the other hand, St. Ali Coffee, a world-renowned Melbourne specialty café makes its Philippine debut also in Opus. Other culinary Opus A-listers are Sogeum by Soban, a premium Korean barbecue concept; Il Lupino, a refined Italian restaurant offering an elevated culinary experience; and coming soon, Nyx by Vikings, a high-end buffet destination where gastronomy meets grandeur.

For family entertainment, Opus features the first Funtopia Park, a steampunk-inspired indoor playground where kids can climb, slide, and explore freely, and the country’s first Family Cinema, redefining how families relax, bond, and enjoy movies together in comfort with world-class technology in cinema sound and laser projection.

Opus also boasts a curated mix of culinary destinations such as Wildflour, Paul, Breakfast at Antonio’s, Key Coffee, Kitchen, Manam, and Sobra Café, along with Epic Eats Food Hall, a lively dining space featuring diverse food concepts, comfortable seating, and an inviting ambiance located on the 4th floor.

“Opus stands out today because of the collective belief of our retail partners who share in our vision. Together, we have created an exceptional place where business, leisure, and community come together harmoniously,” said Faraday Go, EVP and Business Unit General Manager of RLC.

Through A Christmas Masterpiece, Opus affirmed its vision: to redefine the mall experience into a masterpiece of lifestyle and design. Beyond shopping, dining and entertainment, Opus is where culture meets curation, where design and emotion converge, and where every moment is crafted with elegance and intention.

Located within the country’s premier Bridgetowne Destination Estate, Opus stands as Robinsons Land’s latest architectural and lifestyle masterpiece — an evolving refined space designed for leisure-seeking families and discerning urban dwellers. With its upscale interiors, family and pet-friendly atmosphere, and its elevated retail and culinary offerings, Opus embodies RLC’s evolution into the realm of premium developments that inspire a new way of urban living.

Located within Bridgetowne Destination Estate, Opus is Robinsons Land Corporation’s newest premium lifestyle destination. It redefines the modern retail and dining experience through refined design, a curated tenant mix, and a commitment to sophistication and creativity. Opus continues to set the standard for elegance and connection — a space where every experience feels like a masterpiece.

blocks.cap: The Philippine Philharmonic Orchestra filled Opus with breathtaking symphonies that defined the evening’s timeless elegance.
International theater luminary Rachelle Ann Go captivated the guests with her world-class performance.
The celebration was highlighted by the grand lighting of Opus’ magnificent 60-foot Christmas Tree, a radiant centerpiece of the season.
Opus stands as Robinsons Land’s newest premier destination in Metro Manila, a thoughtfully designed space that elevates every moment into something extraordinary.
